svg.text: A 3 x 3 window of the rows x cols array. One series R per cell pitch on every row and every column, so IR drop falls out of SPICE.
row drivers Vdc(x[i]) attach at inp[i]:
the column-0 (near) end of every row line.
col[j][0], the top tap, has no wire above it:
it is the far end of the column line.
Cell (0, cols-1), orange dashes at left,
is farthest from both ends: cols x r_row +
rows x r_col in series. IR-drop worst case.
1 x r_row + 1 x r_col in series.
Readout attaches at out[j]: one 0 V sense source per column (an ideal TIA virtual ground), at the last-row (far) end.
wire segment R: r_row per row pitch, r_col per column pitch
cell conductance g = g_min + w(g_max - g_min)
optional shunt C to vss (0 F default)
Instance names match crossbar.py: rr{i}_{j} row segments, rc{i}_{j} column segments, c{i}_{j} cells. A hop means no connection.
Nodes: row[i][j] is the row-line tap at column j, col[j][i] the column-line tap at row i; only the cell bridges the two.
Row-select (sel[i]) routing is omitted from this view; see cell-1t1r.svg. At c_row = c_col = 0 no capacitor is stamped at all.
